Python bindings for the nccl-extensions communication libraries (nccl_ep, nccl_m2n)

name: libnccl-ep
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.2.0"
  cuda_major: ${{ (cuda_compiler_version | split('.'))[0] if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "0" }}
  cuda_build_string: cuda${{ cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring }}

recipe:
  name: nccl-extensions
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl-extensions/archive/nccl-extensions-v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4a7b7f8ede041e64ccac32c553cb43d9c7430a31a4f7414f2e8e5c707705a4ed
  patches:
    - shared-libraries.patch
    - split-m2n-cmake-exports.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip: not linux or cuda_compiler_version == "None"
  string: ${{ cuda_build_string }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: native-build
    build:
      script: build.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-driver-dev
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - nccl >=2.30.7
        - nccl
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - cuda-version

  - package:
      name: libnccl-ep
    inherit: native-build
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libnccl_ep.so.*
        # These C headers are also inputs to EP's runtime JIT compiler.
        - include/nccl_ep.h
        - include/nccl_ep/**
    requirements:
      run:
        # EP JIT compiles kernels at runtime. Keep the toolkit at least as
        # new as the build; Blackwell CFT kernels require CUDA 13.3+.
        - cuda-nvcc
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-cccl
        - cuda-version >=${{ cuda_compiler_version }},<${{ cuda_major | int + 1 }}.0a0
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f "$PREFIX/lib/libnccl_ep.so.0"
          - test -f "$PREFIX/include/nccl_ep.h"
          - test -f "$PREFIX/include/nccl_ep/device/ht_ep.cuh"

  - package:
      name: libnccl-ep-devel
    inherit:
      from: native-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libnccl_ep.so
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-ep', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-ep', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -L "$PREFIX/lib/libnccl_ep.so"
          - test -f "$PREFIX/lib/libnccl_ep.so"

  - package:
      name: libnccl-ep-static
    inherit:
      from: native-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libnccl_ep.a
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-ep', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f "$PREFIX/lib/libnccl_ep.a"

  - package:
      name: libnccl-m2n
    inherit: native-build
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libnccl_m2n.so
    requirements:
      run:
        # M2N uses compiled kernels; allow CUDA enhanced compatibility.
        - cuda-cudart
        - cuda-version >=${{ cuda_major }}.0,<${{ cuda_major | int + 1 }}.0a0
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - cuda-cudart-dev
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f "$PREFIX/lib/libnccl_m2n.so"

  - package:
      name: libnccl-m2n-devel
    inherit:
      from: native-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        # M2N has no runtime JIT; its C header is needed only by consumers.
        - include/nccl_m2n.h
        - lib/cmake/NCCLM2N/NCCLM2NConfig*.cmake
        - lib/cmake/NCCLM2N/NCCLM2NTargets*.cmake
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-m2n', exact=True) }}
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-driver-dev
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-m2n', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script: test-cmake.sh
        requirements:
          run:
            - cmake
            - ninja
            - cuda-nvcc
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}

  - package:
      name: libnccl-m2n-static
    inherit:
      from: native-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libnccl_m2n.a
        - lib/cmake/NCCLM2N/NCCLM2NStaticTargets*.cmake
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-m2n-devel', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f "$PREFIX/lib/libnccl_m2n.a"
          - test -f "$PREFIX/include/nccl_m2n.h"
      - script: bash test-cmake.sh --static
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-cmake.sh
        requirements:
          run:
            - cmake
            - ninja
            - cuda-nvcc
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}

  - package:
      name: nccl-extensions
    build:
      string: ${{ cuda_build_string }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script: build-python.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - cython >=3.1
        - setuptools >=77.0.3
        - packaging
        - nccl4py
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-ep', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-m2n', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-ep', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libnccl-m2n', exact=True) }}
        - cuda-core >=1.0,<2.0a0
        - cuda-pathfinder >=1.5.4,<2.0.0
        - nccl4py
        - numpy
        - packaging
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - cuda-cudart-dev
        by_name:
          - cuda-version
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - nccl._extensions
            - nccl.ep
            - nccl.m2n
          pip_check: true
      - script: test_bindings.py
        requirements:
          run:
            - python
            - binutils

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl-extensions
  summary: Python bindings for the nccl-extensions communication libraries (nccl_ep, nccl_m2n)
  license: MIT AND Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - python/LICENSE.txt
    - nccl_m2n/third_party/nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT
    - nccl_ep/LICENSE.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - shermansiu
    - conda-forge/cuda
